title: The Dynamic Principle: A Unified Monograph and Computational Laboratory
description: A unified research program built on the dynamic principle: geometry supplies only the integer triple (n, B, λ₀); a universal parameter-free pipeline constructs the spin phases (δ = π/N), the braking (γ = δ⁴/k), the effective corrections (δₑₔ⁴ = δ⁵/k), and the united formula ΔCh = λ₀ − R/4 + δ²/2 − δ⁵/k. The ladder of stands spans the calibration torus (4, 1, 4π²), the Fermat-quartic K3 surface (Néron–Severi rank 20 = max, Shioda), the Klein quartic Jacobian (j = −3375), and the cyclotomic levels N = 15/30 (genera 91 and 406) with a closed system of eight lemmas and six theorems. Certificates A–H cover cycle certification, period-based kernel closure, μ₄-equivariance, flow termination with the exact lcm time, rationalization with a priori denominator bounds, Hodge lattice indices with the Chowla–Selberg layer, and the full Gross Γ-normalization (volume 1125 = √(3⁴·5⁶)). The protocol V1–V9 is fully reproducible in about two seconds; verification runs in Python (mpmath), Julia (BigFloat), Fortran, C, Rust, and the Lean 4 kernel.
